A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully synthesized all the miharamycins sugar moiety analogues, including the miharamy cin sugar moiety, which are required for the synthesis of miharamyci ns A, B and C.
the synthesis of the mihararnycin sugar moiety 5 was accomplished through a new route starting from a conveniently protected C-3' isomer.
we have successfully constructed the miharamy cin sugar moiety having a branched chain and its C-3' analogs, and that the C-3' stereocenter was determined as R.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of 5 is possible through two different routes, one from 8 and another from a ketosugar.
the miharamycins are not the first example of a natural product containing a branched chain in the sugar moiety.
the synthesis of a branched-chain sugar is a key step for the synthesis of the miharomycin sugar moiety and the related analogs.
